description: consumeDiscordLinkSession listed in auth-service effectful shell (behavioral-spec.md line 29) violates the service boundary defined in the source specs. implementation-design-mvp.md line 107 explicitly states 'discord_link_sessions | auth-service（発行）/ billing-service（消費）' — auth-service ISSUES link sessions, billing-service CONSUMES them. REQ-AUTH-004 correctly states session check does NOT consume the token, yet the effectful shell includes a consumption function that no auth-service requirement uses.

evidence.snippet: consumeDiscordLinkSession(db, tokenHash): Promise<LinkSessionRecord | null> — atomic DB UPDATE + SELECT in transaction

recommendation: Remove consumeDiscordLinkSession from auth-service's effectful shell. Link session consumption belongs exclusively to billing-service.
